notes.title: Teller’s Duty Demo Update V.1.0.9 & News
notes.content: [p]Hi Tellers! [/p][p]We’ve just rolled out a fresh update for the demo. Thank you so much for playing, sharing feedback, and reporting bugs. It really helps us polish the game![/p][p][/p][p]Here’s what’s new in this version:[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/6a86b51df60e6a759aaa82d06af3e66293209f0e.png"][/img][/h3][list][*][p]\[Visual] You can now customize your cat’s name[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/d8a1f6c5ca5f70825e4ee7f8699e3d0714c407cc.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/81aaec20e755a608e1c31eb4d315b69d610b18ab.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/fe5de6d509360f1f5529c170a42885a8e8d294ff.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]\[UI] Smoother animations when switching menus[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]\[UI] Redesigned some main menu interface[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]\[Visual] Added window-opening animation before starting a transaction[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/d64ffe65eb51bea6e33dd34af2c8f3735d2e0d04.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]\[Achievement] Steam achievement "Expelled"[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]\[Gameplay] ID card stamp wrong validation [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Other minor bug fixes to improve your teller experience[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We’re also excited to share that Teller’s Duty is joining the Cat Awareness Feline Sale on Steam 2025, Sep 9 - Sep 19 2025, hosted by Devcatgames! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/3919139cea5c2950c112bf2a758ffc4209c9f4ba.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re also happy to announce that [i]Teller’s Duty[/i] has been selected as one of the Top 40 SEA Game Awards Finalists 2025 at Level UP KL, hosted by MDEC! ([url="https://www.instagram.com/p/DOVdR-NjKVT/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link)"]source[/url])[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/39744707156b9e4b36a318a91b23154fca89c847.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]That’s all for now! Keep an eye out for the next update[/p][p][/p][p]See you at the counter,[/p][p]Hiscory Team[/p]

notes.title: Teller's Duty Demo Update V.1.0.4
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/6a86b51df60e6a759aaa82d06af3e66293209f0e.png[/img][list]
[*] [New Feature] Manual Count.
[*] [New Feature] Audio Tape, You can now freely switch songs while working.
[*] [New Feature] Dynamic Transaction, Customer errors are now dynamic and unpredictable, even the developers can’t anticipate what mistakes might come next.
[*] [New Feature] Dynamic light/sun – experience morning and afternoon ambiance as the lighting adapts naturally.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/82fc15bfe6c600abe6ab69edf8121cbc2ed9a513.gif[/img]
[*] [New UI] Enhanced document UI—more readable.
[*] [New Pointer] A pointer grab is now available when interacting with grab-able objects..
[*] [New Characters] More characters and additional transactions added.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/fe5de6d509360f1f5529c170a42885a8e8d294ff.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [UI] Improved some UI.
[*] [Customer] Adjusted some customer dialogues.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/d64ffe65eb51bea6e33dd34af2c8f3735d2e0d04.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [Minor] Fixed some minor bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Teller's Duty Demo Update V.1.0.3
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/6a86b51df60e6a759aaa82d06af3e66293209f0e.png[/img][list]
[*] [New Feature] Multi-preview document feature added.
[*] [New Mini Game] A new mini-game has been added.
[*] [New Feature] Health system added for both the teller and the cat.
[*] [New UI] Enhanced document UI—more readable and mobile-friendly.
[*] [New Characters] More characters and additional transactions added.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/fe5de6d509360f1f5529c170a42885a8e8d294ff.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [Refactor] Refactored all system code for improved stability.
[*] [UI] Improved notification UI tutorial for the money drawer.
[*] [UI] Adjusted the position of interactable objects on the teller desk during the end-of-day summary.
[*] [UI] Adjusted some UI
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/d64ffe65eb51bea6e33dd34af2c8f3735d2e0d04.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [Calendar] Fixed incorrect date issue when returning to the main menu and resuming gameplay.
[*] [Transaction] Fixed invalid transaction validator issue (teller received a warning when it should have been valid).
[*] [Minor] Fixed some minor bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Teller's Duty Demo Update V.1.0.2
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/6a86b51df60e6a759aaa82d06af3e66293209f0e.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added "Tick Tock" sound effects for the clock.
[*] Audio is now muted when the game is paused.
[*] The game now pauses when the application loses focus.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/fe5de6d509360f1f5529c170a42885a8e8d294ff.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Improved dialogue background for better text readability.
[*] Changed some background music.
[*] The clock timer now runs 50% slower in dialogue mode to give players more time to read.
[*] Sync Date Format in Calendar
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447888/d64ffe65eb51bea6e33dd34af2c8f3735d2e0d04.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed date format in game settings.
[*] Fixed cutscene transition bug.
[*] Fixed several minor bugs.
[/list]
